As General Mtrs Co (GM) Shares Declined, Shareholder Kazazian Asset Management Has Decreased by $610,488 Its Holding; Amerigas Partners LP (APU) Stake Raised by Tiedemann Wealth Management Llc
May 30, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Tiedemann Wealth Management Llc increased its stake in Amerigas Partners LP (APU) by 11.47% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tiedemann Wealth Management Llc bought 19,030 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.21% with the market. The institutional investor held 184,932 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.39 million, up from 165,902 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tiedemann Wealth Management Llc who had been investing in Amerigas Partners LP for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.79B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.42% or $0.17 during the last trading session, reaching $40.79. About 137,223 shares traded. AmeriGas Partners, L.P. (NYSE:APU) has declined 6.78% since May 30, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.35% the S&P500.
Kazazian Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in General Mtrs Co (GM) by 9.17% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kazazian Asset Management Llc sold 16,958 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.80% with the market. The institutional investor held 167,977 shares of the auto manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.10M, down from 184,935 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kazazian Asset Management Llc who had been investing in General Mtrs Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $52.69 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.40% or $0.92 during the last trading session, reaching $37.38. About 12.34M shares traded or 11.49% up from the average. General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) has risen 17.48% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 4.91% the S&P500.
Analysts await General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) to report earnings on July, 24. They expect $1.82 earnings per share, down 3.70% or $0.07 from last year’s $1.89 per share. GM’s profit will be $2.57B for 5.13 P/E if the $1.82 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.43 actual earnings per share reported by General Motors Company for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 27.27% EPS growth.
